audit: FIRESTORE FLAG SCHEMA & BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY AUDIT

quickEntryEnabled.semantics: Governed flag for quick entry readiness. When omitted, defaults to false, but does NOT block mission shell selection or Dashboard entry (canQuickStart).

smartEntryEnabled.semantics: Governed flag for smart / diagnostic entry readiness. Evaluated in canSmartStart gate strictly with fail-closed semantics.

missionSelectionReady.semantics: Indicates mission / variant selection readiness. For single-track missions (variantRequired == false), omitting this flag does NOT block selection. For variant-required missions, variant must be selected.

catalogDiscoverable.semantics: Controls catalog visibility. Default is true for non-archived missions.
